tests.name: GET /api/v1/partner-onboarding/<nil uuid>/dpa answers 401 JSON anonymously and 403/404 JSON (never 5xx) for the signed-in test user; Commerce setup hub with a demo lab business served in the browser (page.route): the DPA row reads 'being prepared' (data-state=todo, data-dpa=pending_legal, nothing to click) while no version is published, and with a placeholder version the sheet opens with the declaration unticked and Sign disabled until name, role and tick are there, on phone and desktop without overflow — Sign never clicked, the sign endpoint aborted

parse/sign helpers, the exact sign body (version, German hash, shown locale, trimmed name and role, declaration_confirmed), Sign disabled until name+role+tick, language switch keeps the tick and never signs, German binding notice and fallback, Arabic rtl, catalogue fallback declaration, each refusal code (DPA_SIGNATURE_REQUIRES_SUPPLIER, DPA_NOT_PUBLISHED, INVALID_SHOWN_LOCALE, INVALID_SIGNATURE, ORG_NOT_FOUND, NOT_ORG_ADMIN, DPA_NOT_REQUIRED, DPA_COMPANY_INCOMPLETE, ACCOUNT_EMAIL_REQUIRED) with its own message, 409 DPA_VERSION_MISMATCH/DPA_CONTENT_MISMATCH reload the text and clear the tick, signed and re-sign states in the sheet and the hub row, the row only when the checklist requires a DPA, RTL class scan, copy in all 11 locales
tests.reason: Staging is read-only against the production Supabase project, no DPA version is published there (legal publishes it later through the admin API) and the VTID-05090 migration is applied only after Gate 2, so staging can only observe the guarded read path and the unpublished state. Signing is a write; these Vitests render the real sheet and hub with a mocked gateway and prove every write path and refusal code.
